newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson trade heavy ahead of market open.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson trade heavy ahead of market open.

text.p: A total of 788,060 shares in Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson were traded in pre-market trading at the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Wednesday, the exchange said.
The prices ranged from a low of 237.50 crowns and a high of 252.26 crowns, while the share's offical close was 248 crowns on Tuesday, when the company reported 1996 earnings.

At the lowest level 100,000 shares were brokered within Net brokerage and at the highest level 5,000 shares were brokered by SBC Warburg. The largest single deal was 105,000 shares, brokered within Hagstromer & Qviberg at a price of 241 crowns.
At 0945 GMT, forty-five minutes into the offical Wednesday session, Ericsson's share was changing hands at 246.5 crowns, down 1.5 crowns.
Ericsson reported a 1996 pre-tax profit of 10.15 billion crowns on Tuesday, which was slightly higher than a market forecast of 10.03.
